Challenge in Music City champions |bowl=[[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2016–17 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Middle Tennessee State University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Blue Raiders, led by 15th-year head coach [[Kermit Davis]], played their home games at the [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] and were members of [[Conference USA]]. They finished the season 31–5, 17–1 in [[2016–17 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to win the regular season championship. In the [[2017 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 UTSA Roadrunners men's basketball team|UTSA]], [[2016–17 UTEP Miners men's basketball team|UTEP]], and [[2016–17 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team|Marshall]] to win the C-USA Tournament. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As the No. 12 seed in the South region, they defeated [[2016–17 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2016–17 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]]. == Previous season == The [[2015–16 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 25–10, 13–5 in [[2015–16 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to finish in second place. They defeated [[2015–16 Charlotte 49ers men's basketball team|Charlotte]], [[2015–16 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team|Marshall]], and [[2015–16 Old Dominion Monarchs basketball team|Old Dominion]] to win the [[2016 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]]. As a result, they earned the conference's automatic bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As a No. 15 seed in the Tournament, they upset No. 2 seed and No. 2-ranked [[2015–16 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the first round to become only the eighth No. 15 seed to win an NCAA Tournament game. In the second round, they lost to eventual Final Four participant, [[2015–16 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]]. == Offseason == ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
